answer: Time is the one input a sybil farmer cannot buy in bulk. Gate economic standing on calendar age: each identity's rights accrue at a fixed protocol rate — no transfer, no acceleration, no shortcut to the zenith. When linkage proof exposes a fleet, every puppet's age resets to zero at once, and each must re-mature in real time while earning nothing. Honest incumbents form an ocean of accumulated age no attacker can flood overnight. Treat each fresh identity like a lantern: its age is the light that money cannot fake, and wipes keep the night watch honest.
